name: Ruby High
description: Ruby High is an educational eliza app. Ruby is the host and onboarding personality; specialist faculty (Sally Science for STEM, Professor Edward for mid-century literary theory, more to come) teach their domains. v0.1 ships with Ruby only — faculty plug in later.

RUBY_HIGH_DEFAULT_SUBJECT.description: Optional default subject Ruby falls back to when a student opens the app without specifying one. Example: 'general-knowledge'.

RUBY_HIGH_DEFAULT_SUBJECT.label: Default subject
RUBY_HIGH_DEFAULT_SUBJECT.help: What Ruby teaches if the student doesn't pick a topic.

author: Cenetex Inc.
